evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: A thorough understanding of engineering best practices - from testing paradigms to peer code reviews and resilient architecture design
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Engineering rigor (testing, code reviews, resilient architecture, semantic layers) is balanced with velocity/speed framing ('fast, accurate, data-driven decision-making', 'thrives in fast, team-based, and iterative programming environments'), giving roughly equal weight.
evidence.domain_risk: CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations... stop breaches
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A cybersecurity platform protecting customers from threat actors at massive scale (3 trillion events/day) implies high risk from data errors affecting product reliability and customer trust in a security-critical product.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Our team designs, builds, and maintains the analytics data systems that power the award-winning Falcon Console
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools appear throughout responsibilities and the team already maintains an established analytics platform powering a flagship product, though the role also navigates 'ambiguity and undefined problem spaces' — a mid-maturity signal.
evidence.jd_authorship: You'll capture, transform, and integrate data from multiple sources into a unified analytics platform... using tools like Kubernetes and Docker
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific named tools (Kubernetes, Docker, Snowflake, Tableau) and precise technical scope (semantic layers, data platforms) show exactly what the role involves, though also padded with generic culture/mindset bullets.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: deliver actionable insights on how users interact with our products and services
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on product analytics — how users interact with the Falcon Console — a clearly product-oriented focus.
evidence.autonomy_level: Ask smart questions and shape outcomes, not just do tasks... Own your work and make sure it succeeds
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Ownership and outcome-shaping language is paired with delivering against defined product/business needs and balancing stakeholder trade-offs, giving a mixed profile.
evidence.ai_role: You use AI tools to work faster... Use AI tools daily and share how you use them with the team
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is explicitly expected to use AI tools daily to accelerate their own work — the AI is the candidate's tool, a clear ai_user signal (no AI-consuming infrastructure responsibility is named).
evidence.testing_framing: A thorough understanding of engineering best practices - from testing paradigms to peer code reviews and resilient architecture design
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is listed among general engineering best practices as a qualification rather than framed as an owned responsibility with a dedicated action verb.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: help our customers stay ahead of adversaries
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate — the broader company mission involves stopping breaches and protecting customers, but the role's own responsibilities are framed around delivery and insight generation rather than explicit compliance or regulatory risk.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: This role requires navigating ambiguity and undefined problem spaces, working across multiple product groups and disciplines to drive impact
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mix of navigating undefined/greenfield problem spaces and maintaining/extending the existing analytics platform powering the Falcon Console.
